description: Java class 'InvestorBusinessEventSerializer' that serializes 'InvestorBusinessEvent' objects into Avro format, handling external transfer data, custom data, and related logic within the Fineract project.

classes.name: InvestorBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class converting InvestorBusinessEvent objects into Avro format for external event processing, handling transfer data and custom serialization.

methods.name: getCurrencyFromEvent
methods.description: Extracts currency data from an InvestorBusinessEvent.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Checks if the event is an instance of InvestorBusinessEvent.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the schema class supported by this serializer.

methods.name: getExternalEventCustomDataSerializers
methods.description: Provides the list of custom data serializers.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a BusinessEvent into an Avro DTO, handling transfer data and custom data collection.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the transfer type string based on transfer status.

methods.name: getUnpaidChargeData
methods.description: Collects unpaid charge data from the event's loan charges.

methods.name: addToMap
methods.description: Adds unpaid charge data to a map, aggregating amounts for the same charge.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns a string status based on transfer status.

methods.name: getTransferStatusReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for transfer sub-status if available.
